🚨 A lot happened on Algorand in August!

ICYMI, here's your monthly recap 👇

🟢 The Algorand v5.0.0 protocol upgrade reached the 90% approval threshold from node runners in less than 4 days and is now LIVE on mainnet! 🔥

It was the biggest protocol upgrade since staking rewards went live last year!

👉 Native PQ accounts are now part of the protocol
👉 Fees now scale with resource usage
👉 Builders get bigger contracts + new AVM capabilities

🟢 You can now create and use native post-quantum accounts on Algorand directly via @PeraAlgoWallet  and @LuteWallet! 🔐

Some dapps already support PQ accounts, like @wendottools, @downbad_algo and @yieldling!

900K+ post-quantum transactions have already been signed with Falcon-1024 in just a few days, and you can add yours and claim a Pera post-quantum NFT!

🟢 Algorand launched AC2, an open, blockchain-agnostic protocol for safer AI agent approvals and credential isolation!

👉 Human approvals become verifiable signatures
👉 Credentials stay on your device, not in the agent runtime
👉 Built for payments, code, APIs and other agentic use cases

Let's try AC2 now!

🟢 @AlgoFoundation partnered with @FlowTraders to deepen institutional liquidity and make ALGO more accessible to institutional investors!

🟢 @PeraAlgoWallet v7 is here, and it's their BIGGEST upgrade to date! It has been rebuilt from the ground up, with tons of new features and an improved UX! 📱

🟢 Perps are now live in beta on @alphaarcade!

🟢 HUGE x402 activity on Algorand, the #2 chain by agentic transfer volume in August according to @tokenterminal, with $244K moved by AI agents! 🤖

🟢 In August, the value of tokenized stocks on Algorand climbed 54% to $70M!

🟢 90%+ of all ALGO is now in circulation!

🟢 USDC on Algorand is now supported for real-world merchant payments across SEA, India, Nigeria and Argentina via @AEON_Community! 🌍

🟢 With v5.0, Algorand continues its progress toward broad post-quantum resilience by 2027!

🟢 Validator count keeps growing on Algorand, now surpassing 1.5K! 📈

🟢 Verifiably Random podcast is back for Season 4! 🎙️

👉 EP1: @marcvl, @bmartins_ & @jannotti break down Algorand v5.0.0

👉 EP2: @marcvl & @bmartins_ dive deeper into AC2

🟢 Over 1,500 x402 endpoints are now deployed on Algorand for the Global x402 Challenge!

🟢 A lot of questions were covered during Algorand's latest Reddit Community AMA! Let's take a look! 💬

🟢 @zerosignal_ai beta is live on Algorand, bringing decentralized AI inference with privacy for users and rewards for hardware contributors!

🟢 @Algo_Bharat has now reached 111 Algorand Blockchain Clubs across India, connecting thousands of young devs!

🟢 @1to3carbon, powered by Algorand, launched a blockchain-based registry with Sustainable Business Council NZ to support low-emission freight in New Zealand 🇳🇿

🟢 Legend @ganainmtech joined @riseinweb3 to talk Global x402 Challenge, AC2, AlgoKit + VibeKit, and Algorand v5.0!

🟢 Algorand CEO @StaciW_DC contributed to a new @ubyx_ paper on why regulated institutions should help secure public blockchains as validators

🟢 @mattkeller1 joined @RealAllinCrypto to discuss how Algorand and @HesabPay_ are helping deliver financial support in Afghanistan and Syria! 🤝

🟢 @AlgoFoundation published a great article on instant finality, and why on Algorand, done means done!

🟢 @GoPlausible has been cooking hard this month, introducing Universal Receipts for Algorand agentic platforms and publishing a full x402 getting-started guide!

🟢 @wj_beaumont, Algorand Global Head of Product & Integrations, sat down with @RealAllinCrypto to discuss AI payments, RWAs, tokenization, and what happens when millions of AI agents start transacting 24/7!

🟢  @LoafPickle wrote a great update on Rocca Wallet, already powering two real products on Algorand, with more to come!

🟢 Algorand CSMO @marcvl joined @wrappedxyz and @realmotioninc on the Blockhouse Broadcast for a panel on building the rails for agentic payments!

🟢 @AlgoFoundation made a great comparison between the Algorand Virtual Machine (AVM) and the Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM)!

🟢 @algodevs published a best practices guide for enabling x402 payments on Algorand

🟢 @gabrielkuettel has been cooking with @getvibekit, which just launched its alpha!

🟢 Algorand Sr. Director of Integrations & Dev Tooling, @SilentRhetoric, wrote a great blog post about Algorand v5.0!

🟢 @pact_fi's new website is now live! All LPs are being asked to migrate to the new contracts by 9/21

🟢 A great comparison was made between the four chains (including algorand:native) currently tracked on @tokenterminal's agentic payments dashboard! 👀

🟢 @Blockstream Research picked Falcon-1024 as its preferred lattice-based signature scheme for Bitcoin, co-invented by Algorand CSO @ChrisPeikert and already live on Algorand mainnet!

@Super_Powers_AI Hey Super, build a functional interactive podcast contract and licensing valuation tool inspired by major media network deals (such as the Alex Cooper Call Her Daddy licensing history across Barstool, Spotify, and SiriusXM).

The tool must enable users to input key deal parameters—including total upfront advance, episodes per year, downloads per episode, host-read CPMs, dynamic programmatic CPMs, dynamic slot counts, net split percentages, and IP ownership retainage—and instantly view an interactive breakdown of total gross billings, network fees, advance recoupment curves, creator payout schedules, and lifetime IP value.

Use D3.js (pinned v7) to render dynamic stacked financial distribution charts and a live multi-year recoupment trajectory line graph that instantly updates upon parameter manipulation. Include explicit side-by-side comparison presets modeling typical Barstool IP-revshare structures, Spotify exclusive multi-year licensing deals, and independent distribution with agency ad sales representation. Ensure the first viewport contains full direct manipulation sliders, an instant financial metric overview (Total Annual Gross Revenue, Creator Net Income, Recoupment Month, Network Gross Margin), and visual charts, with no pre-computed static placeholders. Include export functionality for generating a structured CSV execution summary report of modeled deal terms and projected multi-year financial cash flows.

Nope, the main series is called "The Tales from the Six Faced World"  (六面世界の物語) and it focuses on people who left their mark there. 

MT was the first to become famous. But Subyugation was written 3 years before a single word of MT was ever thought. 

Old Dragon's Tale is the story of [-Spoilers-] and tales the story of how that world got created. Recommended only for those who have finished V7 or they will get spoiled. 

Subjugation of the King of the King Dragons focuses on the story of Alex Kalman II Rybak and how he got Kajakut and also how the 48 (50) swords from Julian Jalisco were made.

Then, Chronologically will go MT
Jobless Oblige focuses on the story of the next Death God

And the New Story (which is not a sequel) will focus on a new hero we know nothing about.
